entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is VF88-12-900. And you're damn right I'm not satisfied. These things are torture devices, not shoes. I want a full refund and I want it now!

Okay, thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the cleats, or is it more of a preference and fit issue?

It's an issue with them ripping my feet apart! They give me horrible blisters every single time I ride. I've tried everything. It's a garbage product. If I don't get my money back, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Is that clear?
I understand your frustration completely, Sam. No one wants to end a ride with blisters. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Don't give me the runaround. I know my rights. Just process the refund. I can't believe this. Get me your manager if you can't handle this.
That won't be necessary, Sam. I've just confirmed your order date. You're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Wait, really? A full refund? No questions asked?

That's correct. We stand by our gear, and if it's not working for you within that 90-day period, we're happy to take it back. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you right now. I'll email it to the address on file. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Oh. Okay, then. That's... better than I expected. Fine. Send the label.
The email has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sam?
No, that's it. Just make sure that refund gets processed quickly.
We will. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I'm sorry again that the shoes didn't work out for you.
